content:
We have heard a lot of expected news about Apple's next-generation iPad mini, including that it will adopt an OLED screen and a stronger waterproof design.

Today's new leak points out that the upcoming iPad mini will be equipped with powerful performance: a brand-new A20 Pro chip.

MacRumors today discovered information related to the new iPad mini in Apple's code, including a product icon that appears to be the device.

From the icon, it can be seen that the overall design of the new iPad mini is the same as the existing model. However, the camera has been moved from the top bezel to one side of the landscape orientation, consistent with other Apple iPad models. There is also a small speaker opening at the top of the screen, similar to the design of the iPhone.

The code also shows that the new iPad mini will be equipped with an A20 Pro chip, which is the same chip used in the iPhone 18 Pro series that went on sale last week. The existing iPad mini was launched in October 2024, featuring the Apple A17 Pro chip.

According to Mark Gurman, the new iPad mini is expected to go on sale before the end of October. In addition to the aforementioned changes, the new device is reportedly set to offer better waterproof performance and a brand-new speaker system.

Please read our complete roundup of the expected content of the new iPad mini to learn all the details.
